title: Middle Eastern-Italian Pilaf Casserole
description: A flavorful casserole combining the warmth of Middle Eastern spices with the simplicity of Italian pilaf. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: dried
ingredients.notes: dried herbs of your choice (e.g. thyme, rosemary)

instructions: Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the dried herbs and middle eastern spices in a little olive oil.
Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes.
